dataformat.name: asn1
dataformat.title: ASN.1 File
dataformat.description: Encode and decode data structures using Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1)
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,file

marshalIn.description: BER-encoded data, written as it is. With usingIterator, a byte array or a Bouncy Castle ASN1Primitive, and with unmarshalType as well an object of a class the asn1bean compiler generated

marshalOut.description: The BER-encoded data in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off. With usingIterator, and no unmarshalType, nothing is written for a body that is neither a byte array nor an ASN1Primitive

unmarshalIn.description: BER-encoded data: one record, or several one after the other

unmarshalOut.description: The records, encoded again, in one byte array. With usingIterator, an Iterator for the split EIP: of messages with the bytes of one record each, or of objects of the class unmarshalType names

usingIterator.description: If the asn1 file has more than one entry, the setting this option to true allows working with the splitter EIP to split each entry individually.
